General Questions

Sails.to is a CrossSecurities infrastructure platform that bridges blockchain technology with traditional finance. We enable businesses to issue compliant CrossSecurities that can be held either on-chain on the Solana blockchain or CrossConverted to bankable securities with an ISIN for custody at institutions like Clearstream.

Most tokenization platforms force you to choose: either blockchain-native tokens (inaccessible to traditional investors) or traditional securities (missing blockchain benefits). Our CrossConversion technology lets investors choose their preferred format — and switch between them. You get blockchain speed and programmability with traditional finance legitimacy and accessibility. That's what makes our CrossSecurities unique.

Platform Overview

Sails.to is a compliant platform for issuing, investing in, and distributing security tokens. We combine blockchain efficiency with traditional finance compliance to offer the best of both worlds.

What We Offer

  • Issuers: Tokenize assets, raise capital globally, manage cap tables automatically
  • Investors: Access curated offerings, choose your custody model, receive automated distributions
  • Brokers: Expand your product offering, earn competitive commissions, serve global clients

Key Features

  • Compliant by design: Reg D 506(c) / Reg S framework with full KYC/AML
  • Hybrid custody: Self-custody on Solana or institutional via Clearstream
  • Wyoming DAO LLC: Legal entity recognition with Series LLC protection
  • Secondary trading: Compliant peer-to-peer transfers

What Is a Wyoming DAO LLC?

A Wyoming DAO LLC is a limited liability company that can be managed algorithmically—through smart contracts instead of (or in addition to) human managers.
